actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_all_contacts.description: Retrieve every contact in your Plunk project.
actions.get_contact.description: Retrieve a single contact by ID.
actions.send_transactional_email.descrip: Send a transactional email through Plunk. Recipient can be a single address or a comma-separated list.
actions.send_transactional_email.props.f: Optional sender email. Must be a verified address on your Plunk project.
actions.send_transactional_email.props.n: Optional sender name. Falls back to the project default.
actions.send_transactional_email.props.s: When enabled, Plunk creates the recipient as a subscribed contact if they do not already exist.
actions.send_transactional_email.props.t: Recipient email address. For multiple recipients, separate with commas.
actions.track_event.description: Track a Plunk event for a contact. Plunk auto-creates the contact if they do not exist. Requires the public API key.
actions.track_event.props.data.descripti: Optional metadata stored alongside the event.
actions.track_event.props.email.descript: Email address of the contact the event belongs to.
actions.track_event.props.event.descript: Identifier of the event being tracked, e.g. `order.completed`.
actions.track_event.props.subscribed.des: When enabled, contacts auto-created by this event will be marked as subscribed.
auth.description:
Find both API keys in your Plunk project's API settings.

  - Secret API key (`sk_*`) is required for sending email and managing contacts.
  - Public API key (`pk_*`) is optional.It is only used by the Track Event action.
auth.props.publicKey.description: Required only for the Track Event action.
auth.props.secretKey.description: Used for /v1/send, /v1/contacts, and the Custom API Call action.
description: Open-source email platform for transactional emails, marketing campaigns, and contact management.
